en.title: Refurbished Nintendo Switch 2 Mario Kart Bundle Drops to $419 at Woot
en.summary: A fantastic deal has emerged for the popular Nintendo Switch 2 console, with a refurbished Mario Kart World bundle now available at a significantly reduced price. This offer presents a compelling entry point for those looking to experience the latest Nintendo has to offer.
en.body:
Woot, Amazon's discount outlet, has just slashed the price on a Grade "A" Refurbished Nintendo Switch 2 Mario Kart World Console Bundle, bringing it down to an attractive $419. This represents a further $20 reduction from its previous $439 price point, making it one of the year's standout deals for Nintendo hardware. While Amazon Prime members will enjoy free shipping, non-members can still get it delivered for a nominal $5 fee. It's worth noting that this price is particularly timely, as the console's price is slated to increase on September 1st.

This particular bundle offers a refurbished Nintendo Switch 2 console, which Woot assures has undergone thorough inspection. According to their standards, these units are guaranteed to have minimal cosmetic blemishes and have passed all diagnostic tests, ensuring like-new functionality and the complete removal of any prior user data. The package includes OEM accessories and comes in its retail box. Importantly, the included **Mario Kart World** code is confirmed to be either unused or replaced with a new code, ready for a new owner. The Switch 2 itself has been a powerhouse for Nintendo, boasting a robust library that includes recent hits like **Donkey Kong Bananza**, **Pokemon Legends: Z-A**, and **Kirby Air Riders**. Future releases are also highly anticipated, with a **Star Fox** remake and **Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave** on the horizon. The console's impressive performance also allows for ports of major third-party titles such as **Cyberpunk 2077** and **Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade**, solidifying the Switch 2's position as a serious competitor to other premium handheld gaming PCs.

## A Gateway to Next-Gen Nintendo Gaming

For dedicated Nintendo fans and newcomers alike, this deal represents a prime opportunity to jump into the current generation of Switch gaming without the premium price tag. The Switch 2's hardware capabilities are a significant leap from its predecessor, enabling it to run graphically intensive games at smooth frame rates – a feat impossible on the original Switch. This improved performance opens up a world of gaming experiences, from expansive open-world adventures to fast-paced competitive titles, all playable on the go. The inclusion of **Mario Kart World** in the bundle is a classic Nintendo offering, perfect for casual play and family fun, while the console's broader library ensures there's something for every type of gamer.

## What This Means for Players

This price drop is more than just a good deal; it's an invitation for more players to experience the cutting edge of Nintendo's portable gaming. The refurbished status, coupled with Woot's warranty and inspection process, should provide peace of mind for budget-conscious consumers. With upcoming software releases and the promise of continued third-party support, the Switch 2 is poised to remain a dominant force in the handheld market for years to come. Smart shoppers can snag a powerful, versatile console at a fraction of its original cost, ready to tackle everything from beloved Nintendo franchises to ambitious multiplatform titles.

## What's Next

This Woot deal is available for a limited time, and given the recent price increase announcement, interested buyers should act swiftly. The console bundle comes with a 90-day Woot warranty, offering a solid period to ensure satisfaction with the refurbished unit.

content_raw: Woot, which is owned by Amazon, just launched one of the best deals I've seen this year for a Nintendo Switch 2 console. For a limited time, you can pick up a Grade "A" Refurbished Nintendo Switch 2 Mario Kart World Console Bundle for just $419. Amazon Prime members get free shipping, but even if you don't have a membership the shipping is only $5. This is an additional $20 price drop compared to the original deal last week, which had the Switch 2 console pegged at $439. Keep in mind that the Switch 2 console will go up in price starting September 1 . The refurbished Switch 2 console with 90-day Woot warranty. According to Woot, "this item has been inspected and guaranteed to have minimal cosmetic damage & has successfully passed a full diagnostic test which ensures like-new functionality & removal of any prior-user's personal information. Bundle includes OEM accessories and retail box." According to this forum post by a Woot staffer , "the [Mario Kart World] code was either not used by the original customer and is still in the box or a new game code has been added to the box." Nintendo Switch 2 Mario Kart World Bundle for $419 Several major Switch 2 video games have been released: Mario Kart World, Donkey Kong Bananza, Pokemon Legends: Z-A, Kirby Air Riders, Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment , Pokemon Pokopia, and much more. Several high-profile titles have been announced, like the Star Fox remake and Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave . Triple-A ports are also making their way to the Switch 2 console, including Cyberpunk 2077 and Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade , making the Switch 2 a veritable competitor to pricier handheld gaming PCs. The Switch 2 hardware is powerful enough to run these games at a very playable clip, a feat that's impossible on the original Switch's increasingly outdated hardware.
